title: Opening: date, address and spelling of the Vigne name
summary: Bill Russell opens the tape with the date, address and the spelling of Arthur Vigne's name and his father's first name.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places

blocks.x: I'll make a note on here that we're interviewing Mr. Arthur Veen and the date is November 29th, 1961. What is the address here again?
1457. Do you mind giving your full name, if you have a middle name?
Yes, how the name is spelled because I've seen it in print spelled different ways.
How was his first name spelled? Just regular John? John. J-O-H-N. John. Because some people would spell it like a French, J-E-A-N or something like a French spelling. I've seen it that way.
Just regular John. John Veen, that's how he was known.
